thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: P1 alert: sudden 5xx surge from ingress layer in euc2 (avg 5xx rate 11% over 3m). ALB target group 'rwd-inference-euc2-ingress' showing multiple unhealthy targets, Envoy upstream RSTs reported. Paging on-call.

Ryan (oncall): Ack. I'm on it. Paging infra + netops.

Sara (infra): looking at CloudWatch now — ALB 5xx went from 0.3% -> 11% in ~4m. Target group health in az-b shows 3/10 healthy. Health check latency spiking.

Evan (netops): checking VPC/ENI metrics and AZ-B network fabric — no immediate host-level packet drops, but seeing increased TCP RSTs from NLB->backend. Could be connection exhaustion on backend side.

Sara (infra): pulling envoy logs from a pod in az-b:
```
kubectl logs -n ingress envoy-6f9c -c envoy | tail -n 50
[2026-02-12T10:12:03Z] "upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers.
upstream rtt 0.003s, reset_count=42"
[2026-02-12T10:12:04Z] "upstream response timeout"
```

Ryan (oncall): ok looks like Envoy -> backend resets/timeouts causing healthchecks to fail, ALB marking TG targets unhealthy, which causes traffic redistribution and more overload elsewhere. We need quick mitigation to stop customer impact.

Matt (platform): Two immediate mitigations: 1) Shift traffic away from az-b (weighting/route) 2) Disable connection reuse / lower keepalive on Envoy to avoid exhausted sockets. I'll do (1) now.

Evan (netops): I'll prepare Route53 weighted failover change. Suggest shift 35% of euc2 traffic to euc1 and 25% to euc3 as short-term spread.

Matt (platform): Applying quick weighted update via our infra pipeline:
```
# terraform apply -target=module.route53.weighted_routing -var 'region=euc2'
# set weights: euc2:40, euc1:35, euc3:25
```
(doing a controlled change, rollback ready)

Sara (infra): Also temporarily increasing ALB deregistration delay to 300s so targets drain instead of immediately failing health checks. Running AWS CLI now.
```
aws elbv2 modify-target-group-attributes --target-group-arn arn:aws:elasticloadbalancer:... --attributes Key=deregistration_delay.timeout_seconds,Value=300
```

incident-bot: Change scheduled: route53-weighted-update executed by matt-platform at 10:16 UTC.

Ryan (oncall): change in flight. Monitoring. CS Pager — please prepare customer impact note.

CS Pager: drafting. Initial assessment: ~30 paid customers with euc2 endpoint affinity saw 502/504s between 10:12-10:20 UTC. Will confirm exact list after logs.

Evan (netops): Route53 weights updated. Propagation should be within 60s-2m for most clients.

Sara (infra): adjusted Envoy connection limits on ingress pods in az-b (hot patch) — set downstream keepalive to 30s and increased max connections per worker from 1024 -> 2048 to reduce socket churn. Rolling restart of az-b pods now (gradual).

Matt (platform): also rolled a quick revert of recent envoy config that introduced aggressive upstream connection pooling (rollback in k8s deployment).

Leah (sre): Observability — tracing shows successful connections increasing, 5xx rate falling. Current ALB 5xx at 1.7% (was 11%). Target group healthy count back to 7/10.

Ryan (oncall): Good. Please keep the weighted routing in place for 15m and monitor. If 5xx stays <2% for 15m, we can gradually shift traffic back.

Sara (infra): Agree. Running a 15m timer. I'll also file an API call audit and collect heap/conn metrics from envoy pods for postmortem.

CS Pager: Sent customer comms to affected accounts (initial incident acknowledged, mitigation in progress).

incident-bot: :white_check_mark: Mitigation successful for now — 5xx rate reduced, traffic redistributed. Incident remains P1 for follow-up and RCA.

Ryan (oncall): Handoff plan — I'm handing this to Leah (sre) for deeper investigation and RCA. I'm out in 20m. Leah, will add notes: probable root = connection exhaustion + recent config change to envoy pooling combined with a backend instance restart in az-b.

Leah (sre): Taking over. I'll collect timeline, logs, and plan a postmortem doc. Immediate next steps: collect `netstat`/socket stats from backend instances, full envoy admin dump, and ALB access logs. Will sync with infra and netops.

Evan (netops): I'll also check upstream NLB metrics and cross-AZ retransmit rates.

CS Pager: I'll follow up with customers when we have final impact window and remediation plan (ETA 2-4 hours for full RCA).

Ryan (oncall): Thanks team. Leaving notes + runbook links: https://console.redwood/infrarunbooks/ingress-5xx and incident template. Handing off now to Leah.

Leah (sre): Acknowledged. Will post the RCA draft in #incidents-updates when ready.

incident-bot: Incident thread closed for on-call handoff at 10:35 UTC (handoff -> Leah (sre)).
